question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Realise**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Realise **means to become aware or understand something. (किसी चीज़ के प्रति जागरूक होना या समझना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The community worked together to realise their dream of building a new playground for the children.*
 
 
 
• The sentence suggests that the blank needs a verb that fits the context of selecting an appropriate option.
 
• The word "**realise**" fits in the given sentence because it conveys the idea that both the efforts of the government and the private sector are required to achieve or bring about the plan's educational goals.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Remain **means to continue to exist or stay in the same place. (अस्तित्व में बने रहना या उसी स्थान पर बने रहना)
 
• **Conclude **means to come to a decision or end a discussion. (किसी निर्णय पर पहुंचना या चर्चा समाप्त करना)
 
• **Conduct **means to organize or carry out a particular activity or event. (किसी विशेष गतिविधि या कार्यक्रम का आयोजन या संचालन करना)
